document.about: BMC Genetics 2005, 6(Suppl 1):S31, 'Linkage analysis and association analysis in the presence of linkage using age at onset of COGA alcoholism data', PMC1866754. Its Table 1 (p2) groups its marker, position and P-value columns under `Sex` and `Sex + Smoking`, each label set over the middle of its three columns with no underline of its own. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#351): the two labels were text above the table, and its columns were named `Markers`, `Position(cM)` and `P-value` twice over. Labels centred over the middle of their groups now span the groups that tile the columns past the stub.

checks.issue: #351: the column was named `P-value` alone, the same as the `Sex + Smoking` group's.
